reason: The README clearly describes a DSH Web UI plugin whose primary purpose is rendering model-generated interactive visualizations and HTML cards inside conversations.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话中将模型生成的 HTML 片段渲染为可交互的可视化卡片。
summaries.en: Renders model-generated HTML fragments as interactive visualization cards within DSH Web conversations.

capabilities: Renders model-generated HTML fragments as interactive cards in the DSH Web UI
Supports interactive visualizations, simulators, comparison panels, and UI mockups
Loads static resources from a fixed CDN within the rendered card
